title: Change createLogger to take an options object with a level
prompt: Change createLogger(name) in src/logger.ts to createLogger({ name, level }) where level is "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error" (default "info"). A logger must drop messages below its level. Update every caller in src/: the db and http loggers should use level "warn", the job logger "debug". Keep the log line format exactly as it is today.
